## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:i18n`, into `pm:queue`. The anonymous form translates its section titles again, as #8813 made it, and a pin holds it on the anonymous path

Triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-13T16:51Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Re-checked on `origin/main` (`72594f29ec`):** #8813's fix is still in `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`. The section title renders `sec.name ? sectionLabel(loaded.object, sec.name, sec.label) : sec.label` (`:2432`), on the key `objects.{object}._sections.{name}.label` through `useSafeFieldLabel`. So the name is no longer dropped at build time, and the regression lies on another link of the chain.
- **Why p2:** the regression of a closed p2 (#8813), on a published anonymous surface, in a zh-CN browser. It was measured once on HotCRM at 18.0.0-next.0 (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2093, finding 13).
- **Lane:** `apps/console` is `domain:ui`.
- **Direction:**
  - **First act:** find the broken link on the anonymous path, in the shipped console (`1fb1ced`) and on `main`. The candidates:
    - whether the signed-out session loads the app's translation bundle at all;
    - whether `GET /api/v1/forms/:slug` hands `sec.name` through;
    - whether HotCRM's pack sits under the `_sections` key the console reads. The card cites `objects.pipeline.ts` ~196–198.
    
    The field labels on the same page are translated, so compare their route with the section titles'.
  - If the server's form read is what drops the name or the bundle, the producer is objectstack's: file it there and point this card at it. ⛔ No client-side workaround for a server omission.
  - **Pin:** a signed-out render in zh-CN shows the translated section titles. #8813's pin (`sectionLabelI18n`) covers the signed-in path.
- **Help text and placeholder:** whether a section's `helpText` and a field's `placeholder` have a translation key at all is the same question as objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2094. That question belongs to the spec contract (objectstack `domain:spec`), not to this card.

Claim: PM loop round 1
Session: `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`
Account: `baozhoutao` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-12333-public-form-section-i18n`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12333`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#2`
File surface: `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`, the anonymous path's translation bundle loading in `apps/console/src/` (wherever the signed-out route loads or skips the app's i18n bundle), and their tests (stop on breach; explain in the report)
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default tier; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` reads no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `unknown until measured: objectui's console (the anonymous route's bundle or section-label chain) or objectstack's GET /api/v1/forms/:slug if it drops sec.name; the latter is filed upstream, not worked around | no platform path covers it: the signed-in path does (sectionLabelI18n), the anonymous one regressed | every signed-out visitor of a published form in a non-English locale; measured on HotCRM's contact-us and support forms`
Thread-read: 6150661721
Serial constraints cleared: no in-flight `domain:ui` claim names `FormPage.tsx` or the console's i18n bootstrap (read 2026-10-14T13:21Z). The objectui#12075 claim covers `FlowRunner.tsx` / `flowResponse.ts` / `ScreenView.tsx`, which are disjoint files in the same `area:i18n`.

Release: premise disproved · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` · 2026-10-14T13:50Z

This releases claim `6169359758`. The cause is premise disproved. The card moves `pm:dispatched` → `pm:blocked`, with `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23497` as its body's first line, and the assignee is cleared.

**What the dev measured** (os-dev report above), re-read by the seat on objectstack `origin/main`:
- **The console chain from #8813 is intact.** The key `objects.{object}._sections.{name}.label` is still read at FormPage's section heading.
- **HotCRM's pack matches that key.** It translates `crm_lead._sections.{name}.label`, and `GET /forms/:slug` passes `sec.name` through.
- **The broken link is deliberate.** Since objectstack#22432 the `/i18n` domain answers an anonymous caller 401. Since #12034 the console's `loadLanguage` answers `{}` when signed out. So no client-side bundle exists on the anonymous path.
- **The server localizes only the object schema.** `GET /forms/:slug` translates `objectSchema`, which is why the field labels are Chinese. It returns the form's sections as authored (`packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`, `registerFormEndpoints`).

The producer is objectstack's public form read, so the fix is filed there as objectstack-ai/objectstack#23497. Triage's ruling forbids a console workaround, and none is possible without reopening the anonymous `/i18n` read. No objectui PR was opened. The dev's branch `claude/issue-12333-public-form-section-i18n` sits empty at `2d8450e`.

**Unlock (cross-repo):** objectstack-ai/objectstack#23497 must be closed and the fix must be installable in objectui; a merge upstream alone is not enough. The probe is an installed `@objectstack/*` release whose `GET /forms/:slug` with `Accept-Language: zh-CN` returns the translated section label. When it holds, this card needs no console code change. Two things remain:
- Amend the header of the #8813 pin `FormPage.sectionLabelI18n.test.tsx`. It seeds the bundle itself, so it covers a visitor who holds a bundle, and its claim of "NOTHING wrapped around it that production does not have" stopped holding at #12034.
- Verify the anonymous form in zh-CN.

**Help text and placeholder:** the spec gives a view-level field override no translation key on `18.0.0-next.0`. As triage ruled, that question belongs to the objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2094 family (objectstack `domain:spec`), not to this card.
